title: Copy the best ten
what: Copies the ten House members and company insiders whose disclosed trades did best against the index over the three years before, re-picked every January and July.

# Copy the best ten: backtest

Walk-forward from 2020-01-02 to 2025-05-13, costs included. Each refit saw only what was known on its day.

| year | model | index |
|---|---|---|
| 2020 | +21.3 % | +18.4 % |
| 2021 | +24.0 % | +28.7 % |

## What it does not show

Companies that left the market are missing from free data, so the history flatters every stock picker a little.
